meta.description: Tests a gene list or ranked vector against Reactome pathways with ReactomePA local annotations and documents ReactomeGSA as the comparative-service route.
meta.audit_kind: final-pass re-audit at exact branch tip; prior canonical report/viewer archived under _pre-fix-20260923
meta.inputs_note: Every input used an agent-specific run directory, a copied source tree, a private R library first on .libPaths(), and a PID-recording runner. All process intervention was limited to identified descendants of the audit runner.
meta.executed_k_of_n: 9/9 attempted; 6 reached their semantic assertions, 1 source GSEA run was stopped after failing to complete, 1 was stopped as part of the owned batch after no completed assertion, and 1 documented an unexpected organism-error mode
meta.env: F:/OpenScience/audit-envs/crispr-screen-analyst/r.sh; R 4.4.3, ReactomePA 1.50.0, reactome.db 1.89.0, clusterProfiler 4.14.6, org.Hs.eg.db 3.20.0; no environment mutation
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Assertions and generated CSV/PDF files are reported separately from process exit status; no successful output is presented as a clean run.

practice_boundaries.detail: The source includes non-diagnostic, non-prescriptive practice-boundary guidance.

methodological_ground.detail: The exact ORA and GSEA source logic produced the expected planted results when allowed to reach its assertions.

code_usability.detail: Every audit invocation that loaded ReactomePA exited 2816 after its assertion/output, and the unmodified GSEA source created an owned 22-worker BiocParallel tree that did not finish before termination. A scientific analysis route lacks a usable clean exit contract.

functional_suitability.note: ORA, GSEA, hierarchy and identifier guidance fit Reactome analysis, subject to the runtime blocker.

reliability.note: Input and NULL guidance is strong, but the runnable default GSEA lacks a safe backend/exit contract.

performance_context.note: Scope and references are focused; long narrative remains manageable.

agent_usability.note: Clear decision tree, exact identifier rules and result columns.

human_usability.note: Good explanation of hierarchy and background-universe caveats.

security.note: No credentials, destructive operations, or unsupported clinical claims.

maintainability.note: Examples are explicit but depend on a runtime whose ReactomePA teardown is unstable.

agent_specific.note: Strong boundary and failure-mode prose; a dynamic backend failure overrides it.

recommendations.title: Repair ReactomePA clean-exit contract
recommendations.problem: Every ReactomePA-loaded process exits 2816 after producing output.
recommendations.root_cause: The current Windows ReactomePA dependency stack faults during process teardown even when the requested enrichment result has already materialized.
recommendations.fix: Reproduce in a fresh private R runtime, identify the package/DLL teardown fault, and verify `library(ReactomePA)` plus ORA/GSEA exit 0 before re-audit.

recommendations.title: Make default GSEA backend bounded
recommendations.problem: The exact example spawned 22 workers and did not finish.
recommendations.root_cause: The shipped GSEA route does not register a serial or bounded BiocParallel backend, so it inherits the host's broad default worker count.
recommendations.fix: Set/document an appropriate serial or bounded BiocParallel backend, then verify the unmodified shipped command completes and exits 0 on Windows.

recommendations.title: Correct undocumented-organism error claim
recommendations.problem: The observed error did not match the stated keys-method message.
recommendations.root_cause: The prose hard-codes an error string from a different package/runtime version instead of treating the diagnostic wording as version-dependent.
recommendations.fix: Re-run with a clean exit-capable runtime and replace the prose with the exact current error or hedge it as version-dependent.
